facts.text: NIOSH, MSHA, BLS and CPWR are United States bodies that produce accident statistics: NIOSH researches workplace safety, MSHA regulates mines and records mine accidents, BLS counts workplace deaths and injuries, and CPWR analyzes construction figures.
